messages:
watchdog-bot: ALERT: Elevated p99 latency for `redwood-alpha` in ap-sg1-rack7. Multiple GPU telemetry anomalies detected (ECC counters rising, repeated GPU resets). Node: ash-07. See runbook: https://intra/redwood/runbooks/gpu-failures

maya: seeing the same. ash-07 showing repeated Xid events, p99 up ~420ms for inference tenants pinned to that rack. Can we shift traffic?

samir: grabbing logs now. quick ask — anyone see recent firmware or BIOS changes for ash-07?

liam: running quick probe on ash-07, past 30m: `nvidia-smi` shows repeated Xid 13 and a few NVML reset events. ipmitool sensor shows intermittent 12V rail dips. snippet:
```
GPU0: Xid=13 (GPU page fault)
Fan tach GPU0: 1900rpm -> 0rpm blips
PSU 12V: 11.4V -> 10.8V (transient dips)
```

irene: Voltage sag + fan blips = sketchy PSU or card power draw oscillation. No firmware in the change log for that host. There was a note about a noisy fan last week.

maya: OK let's drain ash-07 to prevent more resets. Re-route workloads and reduce batch sizes in ap-sg1 as a precaution. /redwoodctl drain ash-07

ops-bot: Auto-drain triggered (policy: gpu-reset-count>3). Draining ash-07, migrating pods.

liam: I pushed a temporary canary config to ap-sg1 reducing batch_limit for the heavy model from 8 -> 5 to reduce power draw and tail latency. Monitoring CPU/GPU power now.

samir: created ticket INFRA-5217 and scheduled hardware swap for ash-07 (vendor SLA window tomorrow 03:00 SGT). CC: vendor-support.

irene: also adding a short-term alert for PSU rails: `psu_voltage_12v < 11.0V for 3m` on rack7. If it trips again, escalate to on-call hardware team immediately.

maya: will add `bad_gpu:true` label to the device in inventory so autoscaler avoids it until swap.

liam: collecting telemetry CSVs for the last 48h (power rails, fan tach, ECC counts). I'll attach to INFRA-5217.

maya: good plan. thanks all — keep an eye on p99, and if we see resets elsewhere we may need broader throttling policy. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Drain completed. Pods moved off ash-07 -> ash-02/ash-05. No active pods left.

samir: note for postmortem: check if workload power draw pattern changed (recent model rollout?), and validate PSU firmware/SMART.

maya: ack. I'll coordinate postmortem writeup after vendor swap.

liam: uploading telemetry now.

irene: filing follow-up task to consider node-level power capping autosettings to prevent sudden rail sag during high batch bursts.

maya: thanks team, leaving this thread open until swap completes.
